---
title: Enable Soroban tokens
description: Add smart contract tokens to your Varial wallet
---

With a funded Stellar account, you can now add Soroban tokens to your Varial wallet.

1. On the Varial account screen, click `Add token` at the end of your token list.

2. On the next screen, enter the Token ID of the token you want to add to Varial and click the `Add` button when it appears. Click `Confirm` to add it to your wallet.

3. You will now see your token's balance on Varial's account page. Clicking on the balance will show a history of payments sent using this token.
